phasing_details.phase_detail: single phase (to be completed within approved condition period)

description: Installation of 1No. BT Street Hub Unit and associated advertisement panels on either side of the unit
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-54ad7319-7fff-8627-3326-9d8b044e3199"><span style="font-size: 10.5pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed advertisement, by reason of its scale, siting, appearance and method of illumination would result in an obtrusive and visually incongruous feature that contributes to an unsightly proliferation and clutter of signage and street furniture in the local area that would detract from the visual amenity of the street scene and harm the setting of the adjacent Listed Buildings. As such, the proposal would be contrary to policies D3 (Optimising Site Capacity through the Design-Led Approach), D8 (Public Realm) and HC1 (Heritage conservation and growth) of the London Plan (2021) and policies PP1 (Public Realm), LP1 (High Quality Design), LP3 (Designated Heritage Assets) and LP7 (Advertisements) of Hackney's Local Development Plan (2020).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-be1bcc53-7fff-71c3-2f2e-6768de3dedf8"><span style="font-size: 10.5pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed advertisement, by reason of its scale, appearance, location and potential uses would result in an obstructive and intrusive form of development that would increase potential loitering, creating blocks and reducing the amount of space available for use by pedestrians and would block lines of sight and create distraction for highway users reducing the safety of the highway. As such the proposed development is contrary to policies D8 (Public Realm), T2 (Healthy Streets) of the London Plan (2021) as well as policy PP1 (Public Realm), LP7 (Advertisements), LP41 (Liveable Neighbourhoods) and LP42 (Walking and Cycling) of the Hackney Local Plan.</span></span></p>
